affordances.method: rendered overflow and semantic affordance heuristics; requires product-intent review

icons.method: rendered control content and common-action keyword heuristic

prompts.issue: 10 common action controls use text without a detected icon. Consider adding icons where they improve scanning; do not add decorative icons mechanically.

icons.note: Text-only controls are not automatically defects. Recommend icons for recognition, density, or cross-language scanning—not decoration alone.

colorSystem.method: same-origin CSSOM custom-property and color-literal analysis

prompts.issue: 14 non-tokenized color literals appear only once. Review whether they are necessary exceptions or should converge on shared semantic tokens.

colorSystem.note: Brand art, photos, gradients, data-series colors, and deliberate state colors may be valid exceptions. Confirm intent before replacing them.
